items.title: 高配版貴過iPhone Duo！「全球首個可變形個人機器人」啟元T1要價人民幣19999元起
items.title_en: High-End Version Costs More Than an iPhone Duo! The World’s First Transformable Personal Robot Qiyuan T1 Starts at RMB 19,999
paras: 中國上緯新材旗下啟元機器人今(20)日召開產品發表會，發表兩款產品啟元Q1和啟元T1。上緯新材執行長田華宣布產品價格，啟元Q1售價19999元(人民幣，下同)，啟元Q1探索版售價26999元起，啟元T1則賣19999元，啟元T1Pro售價則為29999元。
另據上緯新材料科技股份有限公司董事長、智元機器人共同創辦人兼技術長彭志輝介紹，啟元Q1主打自訂特性，支援自訂設計互動動作、3D列印改造外觀，使用者可自由調整機器人的外觀造型、性格特質、動作姿態與語音音色。
不同於市面標準化機器人產品，啟元Q1希望打破統一標準答案，如同飼養寵物一般，用戶投入不同時間，就能塑造出具備個人特色的機器人，給使用者充足的創意發揮空間。
在外觀造型上，啟元Q1是業界為數不多支援3D列印的個人機器人，造型完全開放，用戶可發揮創意做個人化改造，定義機器人外觀。此外，機器人的個性、動作、說話語氣音色都能夠按使用者喜好調整。
彭志輝認為，機器人最有意思的地方不是它出廠時是什麼樣子，而是它還能被你變成什麼樣子。
他並指出，啟元Q1的定位是「你的第一個個人機器人」，重點面向家庭場景打磨，無需持續遙控即可實現自主跟隨，還可適配戶外模式。
paras_en: China’s Shanghai‑based Shàngwěi New Materials held a product launch today (20th), unveiling two robots – the Qiyuan Q1 and Qiyuan T1. Shàngwěi CEO Tian Hua announced the pricing: the Qiyuan Q1 is priced at RMB 19,999, the Qiyuan Q1 Explorer edition starts at RMB 26,999, the Qiyuan T1 sells for RMB 19,999, and the Qiyuan T1 Pro is priced at RMB 29,999.

According to Peng Zhihui, chairman of Shàngwěi New Materials Technology Co., Ltd., co‑founder and CTO of ZhiYuan Robotics, the Qiyuan Q1 focuses on customizability, supporting user‑designed interactive motions and 3D‑printed exterior modifications. Users can freely adjust the robot’s appearance, personality traits, movement postures, and voice timbre.

Unlike standardized robots on the market, the Qiyuan Q1 aims to break uniform solutions; it’s meant to be nurtured like a pet. The more time a user invests, the more the robot can develop a personal character, giving users ample creative freedom.

In terms of design, the Qiyuan Q1 is one of the few personal robots in the industry that supports 3D printing. Its shape is completely open, allowing users to unleash creativity for personalized modifications and define the robot’s look. Moreover, the robot’s personality, motions, and speech tone can be tuned to the user’s preferences.
Peng Zhihui believes the most interesting aspect of a robot is not how it looks when it leaves the factory, but what it can become through the owner’s modifications.

He also noted that the Qiyuan Q1 is positioned as “your first personal robot,” targeting home scenarios. It can operate autonomously without continuous remote control, follow users on its own, and even switch to an outdoor mode.

items.title: 10月股市「崩盤魔咒」是迷思？分析：反而是逢低布局機會
items.title_en: Is the October Stock‑Market “Crash Curse” a Myth? Analysis: It May Actually Be a Buying‑the‑Dip Opportunity
paras: 10月向來被視為美股崩盤高風險月份，但分析人士指出，投資人對「10月魔咒」的擔憂，反而可能壓低市場表現，創造逢低布局機會。歷史數據顯示，標普500指數自1957年以來，有93%的年份在10月低點後上漲至年底，平均漲幅達7.4%，幾乎是其他11個月份平均漲幅的2倍；研究亦發現，10月並不存在特殊的股市崩盤風險。
根據《MarketWatch》報導，分析認為，市場情緒可能是造成這項季節性現象的關鍵因素。
報導以一群專注於那斯達克市場、由數十名股市擇時操作者組成的樣本為例，觀察他們建議的平均股票曝險比率，因為這部分股市對散戶投資人情緒的變化尤其敏感。
分析顯示，自2000年以來，10月對這部分市場的平均股票曝險比率，僅略高於其他11個月份的一半，分別為13.6%與26.1%。因此，股市自10月低點反彈的現象，正是逆向分析的經典例證。

研究顯示10月並無特殊崩盤風險

更值得注意的是，兩項研究指出，投資人10月降低股票曝險，主要與市場情緒有關，而非當月存在特殊的基本面風險。
其中，哈佛大學經濟學與金融學教授Xavier Gabaix及其共同研究者建立了一套複雜模型，用以估算股市在10月的任何一天出現極端單日崩盤的機率。
研究顯示，任何一個10月出現類似1987年股災、道瓊工業指數單日重挫22.6%的崩盤，機率僅為0.06%；至於出現類似1929年股災、單日下跌12.8%的情況，機率則為0.30%。
同時，Gabaix亦表示，這些極低的崩盤機率適用於所有月份，10月並沒有特殊之處，因此股市歷史上最嚴重的兩次崩盤恰好發生在10月，幾乎可以確定只是巧合。
他表示：「就我們所知，沒有特別理由顯示10月的崩盤機率會高於其他月份。」
另一項顯示股市崩盤風險目前並未升高的研究，則是由哈佛大學的Robin Greenwood與Andrei Shleifer，以及香港大學的Yang You共同進行。他們並未聚焦於單日股市崩盤的發生機率，而是著眼於股市在2年內下跌40%的可能性。
State Street Markets在徵詢Greenwood的意見後，以這項研究為基礎，進一步建立了該公司稱為「美國市場泡沫預測」的指標。根據這項預測的最新更新結果，未來2年美股下跌40%的機率，與歷史平均值相比並無顯著差異。
報導總結稱，整體而言，若投資人僅因10月即將到來，便擔心未來幾週可能爆發股市崩盤，現有研究並不支持這項憂慮。
儘管股市仍可能走跌，但單憑月份進入10月，並不足以認定市場面臨更高的崩盤風險。
paras_en: October has long been viewed as a high‑risk month for a US stock‑market crash, but analysts say investors’ worries about the “October curse” may actually depress market performance and create buying‑the‑dip opportunities. Historical data show that since 1957 the S&P 500 has risen after its October lows in 93% of years, gaining an average of 7.4% by year‑end – roughly twice the average gain of the other eleven months – and research also finds no special crash risk in October.
According to MarketWatch, analysts believe market sentiment may be the key driver of this seasonal pattern.

The report cites a sample of dozens of market‑timing practitioners who focus on the Nasdaq, observing the average equity‑exposure ratios they recommend, because that segment of the market is especially sensitive to retail investor sentiment shifts.

Analysis shows that since 2000 the average equity‑exposure ratio for this segment in October is only slightly higher than the average for the other eleven months – 13.6% versus 26.1% – making the post‑October‑low rebound a classic contrarian example.

Research shows October carries no special crash risk. More notably, two studies find that investors lower equity exposure in October mainly due to sentiment, not because of any unique fundamental risk that month.
Harvard economics and finance professor Xavier Gabaix and co‑authors have built a sophisticated model to estimate the probability of an extreme single‑day crash on any day in October.
The study finds the chance of a crash comparable to the 1987 crash – a 22.6% one‑day drop in the Dow – is only 0.06%, while the probability of a 1929‑type crash – a 12.8% one‑day fall – is 0.30%.

Gabaix also notes that these extremely low crash probabilities apply to all months; October is no different, and the fact that the two worst crashes in history happened in October is almost certainly a coincidence.
He says, “As far as we know, there is no particular reason to think the crash probability in October is higher than in other months.”

Another study showing that crash risk is not currently elevated was conducted by Harvard’s Robin Greenwood and Andrei Shleifer together with Hong Kong University’s Yang You. Rather than focusing on single‑day crash probabilities, they examined the likelihood of a 40% market decline over a two‑year horizon.

After consulting Greenwood, State Street Markets used this research to develop its “U.S. Market Bubble Forecast” indicator. The latest update of that forecast shows the probability of a 40% drop in US equities over the next two years is not significantly different from the historical average.
The report concludes that, overall, existing research does not support the concern that the mere approach of October should make investors fear an imminent market crash in the coming weeks.
While markets can still decline, simply entering the month of October is insufficient to deem the market facing a higher crash risk.

items.title: 減持輝達？黃仁勳被代扣4.57萬股繳稅 4高管也被扣逾11.5萬股 財務長先套現765萬美元
items.title_en: Selling Nvidia? Jensen Huang Withheld 45,728 Shares for Taxes, Four Executives Also Had Over 115,000 Shares Withheld, CFO Cashes Out $7.65 million
paras: 最新文件顯示，包括執行長黃仁勳在內的5名輝達高層合計出售16萬股公司股票用以繳稅。
根據輝達周六(18日)向美國證交會(SEC)提交的一份Form 4文件，由於限制性股票單位(RSU)歸屬產生稅款而被動代扣股票，黃仁勳被代扣4萬5728股普通股，每股計價212.170萬美元，對應價值約970萬美元。
文件指出，這些股份由輝達扣留，用於滿足黃仁勳因RSU歸屬而產生的稅務義務，並非公開市場出售。
除黃仁勳以外，輝達財務長Colette Kress、營運長Debora Shoquist、總法律顧問兼秘書Timothy Teter及會計漲Scott Gawel也在上周三(16日)進行類似的股份代扣，四人代扣股份分別為40747股、350088、35738股和25388股和25388股。
不過，不同於其他四人，Kress上周四(17日)也透過公開市場實際出售，分三筆賣出共34918股，依據其於2026年6月16日制定的Rule 10b5-1交易計畫執行，合計交易金額約764.9萬美元。
輝達Form 4文件也揭露了一項不同性質的股份變動。黃仁勳夫婦的Jen-Hsun & Lori Huang Living Trust信託上周四無償轉讓43.8萬股輝達股票，其中29.2萬股捐贈給The Jen-Hsun & Lori Huang Foundation基金會，另有14.6萬股轉入一個捐贈者建議基金(donor-advised fundor-advised fundor)。
上周五(18日)，輝達收漲1.34%至每股222.27美元，總市值5.36兆美元。
paras_en: The latest filings show that five Nvidia senior executives, including CEO Jensen Huang, collectively sold 160,000 shares of company stock to cover taxes.

According to a Form 4 filed by Nvidia with the SEC on Saturday (the 18th), Huang had 45,728 shares of common stock withheld to satisfy tax liabilities arising from the vesting of restricted stock units (RSUs), each valued at $212.170, for a total approximate value of $9.7 million.
The filing notes that these shares were retained by Nvidia to meet Huang’s tax obligations from RSU vesting and were not sold on the open market.

In addition to Huang, Nvidia’s chief financial officer Colette Kress, chief operating officer Debora Shoquist, general counsel and secretary Timothy Teter, and accountant Scott Gawel also had similar share withholdings last Wednesday (the 16th), with the four executives having 40,747, 350,088, 35,738 and 25,388 shares respectively withheld.

Unlike the other four, Kress also sold shares on the open market on Thursday (the 17th), disposing of a total of 34,918 shares in three transactions under her Rule 10b5‑1 trading plan dated June 16 2026, for an aggregate proceeds of about $7.649 million.

The Form 4 also disclosed a different type of share movement: the Jen‑Hsun & Lori Huang Living Trust transferred 438,000 Nvidia shares without consideration last Thursday, of which 292,000 shares were donated to the Jen‑Hsun & Lori Huang Foundation and another 146,000 shares were placed into a donor‑advised fund.
On Friday (the 18th), Nvidia rose 1.34% to $222.27 per share, giving the company a market value of $5.36 trillion.

items.title: 首展LPDDR6！長鑫科技新品與「豆包手機」一同亮相  LPDDR5X全面進入陸主流旗艦機
items.title_en: First Showcase of LPDDR6! ChangXin Technology’s New Products Debut Alongside the “Doubao Phone” as LPDDR5X Enters Mainland Flagship Phones
paras: 中國DRAM大廠長鑫科技周日(20日)在合肥舉行的2026世界製造業大會上，正式發布第五代DRAM技術平台(下稱G5平台)，並同步展出基於該平台打造的大容量LPDDR5X新品，以及搭載長鑫最高速率10667Mbps的LPDDR5X記憶體的AI智能體手機「豆包手機」(努比亞NaviX Ultra)。努比亞由中國中興通訊與字節跳動共同研發
G5平台的核心突破在於製程微縮。該平台依托創新的四重曝光技術，將記憶體陣列的主動區半間距微縮至11.95奈米，接近全球最頂尖的DRAM量產製程；透過製程變革與新材料應用，記憶體電容深寬比達45:1，並開發適配DRAM製程的高介電常數金屬閘門(HKMG)製程縮小到6762。
本次大會同步展出兩款基於G5平台打造的LPDDR5X量產產品，單顆容量均為24Gb，較上一代同型產品提升50%，分別採用496Ball、245Ball封裝規格，可適配中高階智慧型手機、隨身消費電子等不同場景，目前皆已進入規模量產階段。
LPDDR5X即第五代超低功耗雙倍資料速率同步動態隨機記憶體，主要針對智慧手機、穿戴裝置、平板電腦等行動裝置。
現場另一焦點是上8月底剛宣布量產的LPDDR6。長鑫科技表示，該產品已於8月29日實現量產，最高傳輸速率達12800Mbps，較上一代LPDDR5X提升約20%、功耗降低20%，首批搭載於小米18 Fold摺疊旗艦手機，代表中國記憶體企業首次在高階記憶體標準上實現全球首發量產。
paras_en: On Sunday (the 20th), Chinese DRAM giant ChangXin Technology unveiled its fifth‑generation DRAM technology platform (hereafter the G5 platform) at the 2026 World Manufacturing Conference in Hefei, and simultaneously displayed a high‑capacity LPDDR5X product built on this platform, as well as the AI‑smart “Doubao Phone” (Nubia NaviX Ultra) that incorporates ChangXin’s fastest‑rate 10,667 Mbps LPDDR5X memory. The Nubia phone is co‑developed by China’s ZTE and ByteDance.

The core breakthrough of the G5 platform lies in process miniaturization. Leveraging an innovative quadruple‑exposure technique, the active region half‑pitch of the memory array is shrunk to 11.95 nm, approaching the world’s most advanced DRAM mass‑production nodes; through process innovation and new material usage, the memory cell’s depth‑to‑width ratio reaches 45:1, and a high‑k metal‑gate (HKMG) process adapted for DRAM has been scaled down to 6,762 Å.

The conference also showcased two LPDDR5X mass‑production products built on the G5 platform, each with a single‑chip capacity of 24 Gb— a 50 % increase over the previous generation’s same‑type parts. They use 496‑ball and 245‑ball package specifications respectively, making them suitable for mid‑to‑high‑end smartphones, portable consumer electronics and other scenarios, and both are already in full‑scale production.
LPDDR5X is the fifth‑generation ultra‑low‑power double‑data‑rate synchronous dynamic random‑access memory, primarily targeted at smartphones, wearables, tablets and other mobile devices.

Another highlight on site was the LPDDR6 that was announced for mass production at the end of August. ChangXin said the product entered volume production on August 29, achieving a peak transfer rate of 12,800 Mbps— about 20 % faster than the previous‑generation LPDDR5X and with 20 % lower power consumption. The first batch will be used in Xiaomi’s 18 Fold flagship folding phone, marking the first time a Chinese memory company has achieved a global first‑to‑market mass production of a high‑end memory standard.

items.title: 《大賣空》原型質疑AI放緩論背後「有盤算」！稱OpenAI、Anthropic成AI產業「脆弱環節」
items.title_en: The ‘Big Short’ Inspiration Questions the Motives Behind Calls to Slow AI, Calling OpenAI and Anthropic the Industry’s ‘Achilles Heels’
paras: 電影《大賣空》原型、曾準確預測2008年房市崩盤的投資人Steve Eisman表示，他並不擔心所謂的「機器人末日」，反而認為，部分人工智慧（AI）業者大肆警告技術可能導致災難，背後可能存在特定利益考量。
根據《Business Insider》報導，Eisman近日接受訪問時指出，頂尖AI實驗室近期呼籲放慢技術開發速度，可能是因為這些企業意識到自身缺乏足以抵禦競爭的「護城河」，因此試圖製造危機感。
近期，AI可能引發全球性災難的討論持續升溫。前Anthropic研究員Jacob Coxon公開辭職，便是出於對AI開發商未充分重視安全問題的疑慮。
儘管外界對AI是否可能導致末日情境仍存在不同看法，但Eisman認為，他認為這波恐慌背後存在特定目的。
他認為，這些企業希望製造一場危機，促使政府推出監管措施，之後再設法操控監管制度，建立由兩家企業主導的雙寡頭市場，藉此取代過去曾為其商業模式築起屏障的護城河。
Eisman並指出，AI產業過去透過最大化模型使用量來推動成長的「tokenmaxxing」時代已經結束，開放權重模型正逐步搶占市場，讓相關企業感到不安。
近期也有其他業者指出，AI產業的高速擴張正面臨挑戰。Citadel Securities日前表示，成本上升已讓AI交易熱潮面臨現實考驗，部分市場動能因此受到抑制。
Eisman透露，他近期已降低自身對AI產業的投資曝險。幾週前，他曾對AI市場提出疑慮，並將OpenAI與Anthropic形容為AI交易中的「阿基里斯腱」，即整個產業鏈的脆弱環節。
他表示，OpenAI與Anthropic在整個AI產業鏈中占據相當大的比重，若其中一家出現問題，可能導致整條產業鏈受到嚴重衝擊。
值得注意的是，在這兩家公司之中，Eisman認為OpenAI的狀況較為脆弱。
Anthropic執行長Dario Amodei近期呼籲放慢AI開發速度，OpenAI執行長奧特曼（Sam Altman）及SpaceX執行長馬斯克也表達過類似觀點。
考慮到到Anthropic正準備進行首次公開募股（IPO），Eisman也對Amodei提出相關呼籲的動機抱持懷疑。
Eisman說：「當你說我們應該放慢腳步，因為事情很危險時，我的回應是：『真的嗎？那就延後你的IPO。』」然而，他強調，自己沒有聽說過有人在談延後IPO或暫緩募資。
paras_en: Investor Steve Eisman, the real‑life inspiration for “The Big Short” who accurately predicted the 2008 housing market collapse, says he is not worried about a so‑called “robot apocalypse.” Instead, he believes that some AI firms’ loud warnings that the technology could cause disaster may be driven by specific interests.

According to Business Insider, Eisman said in a recent interview that the top AI labs’ recent calls to slow the pace of development may be because these companies realize they lack a defensible “moat” against competition, and are therefore trying to manufacture a sense of crisis.

Discussion about AI potentially triggering a global catastrophe has been heating up. Former Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon publicly resigned, citing concerns that AI developers were not taking safety issues seriously enough.
Although opinions differ on whether AI could lead to an apocalyptic scenario, Eisman thinks there is a specific purpose behind the current wave of panic.

He argues that these companies want to create a crisis that will prompt governments to introduce regulation, after which they can try to shape the regulatory framework to create a duopoly led by two firms, thereby replacing the moat that previously protected their business models.

Eisman points out that the era of “token‑maxxing,” where the AI industry drove growth by maximizing model usage, is over, and open‑weight models are gradually taking market share, unsettling incumbent firms.

Other players have also noted that the rapid expansion of the AI sector is facing headwinds. Citadel Securities recently said rising costs are putting the AI trading boom to the test, dampening some market momentum.

Eisman disclosed that he has recently reduced his exposure to AI investments. A few weeks ago he voiced doubts about the AI market and described OpenAI and Anthropic as the “Achilles heels” of AI trading – the fragile links in the industry chain.
He said OpenAI and Anthropic occupy a very large share of the AI value chain, and a problem at either company could cause a severe shock to the entire industry.
It is worth noting that, of the two, Eisman considers OpenAI to be the more vulnerable.
Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei has recently called for a slowdown in AI development, and both OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and SpaceX CEO Elon Musk have expressed similar views.
Given that Anthropic is preparing for its initial public offering, Eisman is skeptical of Amodei’s motives for making the call.

Eisman said, “When you say we should slow down because things are dangerous, my response is: ‘Really? Then postpone your IPO.’” However, he emphasized that he has not heard anyone actually discuss delaying an IPO or pausing fundraising.

items.title: 華爾街估Fed今年再升息2次 甚至一路升到「經濟出事」
items.title_en: Wall Street Predicts Fed Will Raise Rates Twice More This Year, Possibly All the Way to an "Economic Crisis"
paras: 美國銀行(BAC-US) 認為，聯準會已展開新一波升息循環，直到今年底前的每場會議都可能升息。
美銀在最新報告指出，繼9月份調升1碼後，預期聯準會今年還會再升息兩次。目前市場定價最有可能的情形是2026年再升息一次，主要聚焦於12月的利率決策會議。
不過，美銀提出市場可能低估升息次數的兩項理由。首先，美國經濟依然強勁，支持通膨可能持續居高不下的看法。通膨仍具黏性，過去兩個月消費者物價指數（CPI）年增率均維持在3.4%。
升息反成華許政治利多
其次，美銀指出，儘管美國總統川普一再要求聯準會降息，但對聯準會主席華許而言，升息實際上似乎已變得「有利於政治操作」。
油價上漲與美國財政部的債券回購計畫，引發投資人對通膨進一步升溫的疑慮。聯準會升息有助於壓抑長期債券殖利率，而10年期與30年期美債殖利率先前大幅攀升，已開始對股價構成壓力。
因此，美銀認為，聯準會此時採取鷹派立場，反而有利金融市場，也有助提升華許的政策公信力。
美銀美國經濟學家巴夫（Aditya Bhave）在報告中寫道：「幾個月前，聯準會升息在政治上看來仍充滿挑戰，但如今愈來愈像是華許建立個人政治遺產的機會。」
有助擺脫政治干預疑慮
談到9月升息時，巴夫進一步表示，這次升息首先緩解了外界對華許缺乏政治獨立性的疑慮，若進一步升息，將能徹底終結相關爭論。
另一方面，華許在接任聯準會主席後僅第三次會議便決定升息，不僅可將自己與既有通膨問題切割，未來數月若通膨降溫，也能將成果歸於其政策。
巴夫預測，聯準會在2026年底前連續升息三次後，政策調整將進入一段較長時間的暫停期。
升息循環恐才剛開始
文藝復興總體經濟研究（Renaissance Macro Research）經濟學主管杜塔（Neil Dutta）也表示，華許的鷹派程度可能比部分投資人預期的還要深。
杜塔指出，儘管華許一向反感前瞻指引，但他在上週三的會議上仍透露出其對貨幣政策的鷹派立場。例如，華許警告高商品價格暗示了通膨壓力，他同時提及將「更即時」地讓通膨率重返2%，並將該次升息形容為僅是撤除「一劑寬鬆政策」。
這讓杜塔得出結論，聯準會的升息循環「離結束還早，更接近開端」。他並補充：「華許很有可能會持續升息，直到經濟出現狀況為止。」
他回顧華許先前在聯準會任職的經歷指出，華許過去就曾為了達成雙重使命中的通膨目標，而願意放任勞動市場下滑，他目前的所作所為顯示，他願意再次這麼做。
paras_en: Bank of America (BAC-US) believes the Federal Reserve has started a new cycle of rate hikes, with each meeting through the end of the year potentially resulting in a hike.

In its latest report, BofA notes that after the one‑basis‑point increase in September, the Fed is expected to raise rates twice more this year. The market’s most likely pricing scenario is a further hike in 2026, focused on the December policy meeting.

However, BofA cites two reasons the market may be underestimating the number of hikes. First, the U.S. economy remains strong, supporting the view that inflation could stay elevated. Inflation remains sticky, with the CPI annual rate holding at 3.4% for the past two months.
Rate hikes turn into a political boon for Powell
Second, BofA points out that although former President Trump repeatedly urged the Fed to cut rates, for Chair Jerome Powell the hikes appear to have become "politically advantageous."

Rising oil prices and the Treasury’s bond‑buyback program have sparked investor concerns that inflation could heat up further. Rate hikes help suppress long‑term bond yields, and the recent sharp rise in 10‑year and 30‑year Treasury yields has already begun to pressure equity prices.
Thus, BofA argues that the Fed’s hawkish stance at this moment actually benefits financial markets and bolsters Powell’s policy credibility.

BofA U.S. economist Aditya Bhave wrote in the report: "A few months ago, rate hikes still seemed politically challenging for the Fed, but now they increasingly look like an opportunity for Powell to build a personal political legacy."
Helps allay concerns about political interference
Discussing the September hike, Bhave added that the move first eased doubts about Powell’s political independence, and further hikes could finally put the controversy to rest.

Moreover, Powell’s decision to raise rates at his third meeting as Fed chair not only distances him from existing inflation problems, but if inflation cools in the coming months, he can claim credit for the improvement.
Bhave forecasts that after three consecutive hikes by the end of 2026, the Fed will enter a relatively long pause in policy adjustments.
Rate‑hike cycle may have only just begun
Neil Dutta, head of economics at Renaissance Macro Research, also said Powell’s hawkishness could be deeper than some investors expect.

Dutta noted that although Powell traditionally dislikes forward guidance, he signaled a hawkish stance at last Wednesday’s meeting. For example, Powell warned that high commodity prices signal inflation pressure, said he would bring inflation back to 2% "more promptly," and described the hike as merely removing "one dose of accommodative policy."

This led Dutta to conclude that the Fed’s rate‑hike cycle "is far from over, closer to its beginning." He added, "Powell is very likely to keep raising rates until the economy shows signs of trouble."

He recalled Powell’s earlier tenure at the Fed, noting that Powell previously allowed labor‑market weakness to achieve the dual mandate’s inflation target, and his current actions suggest he is willing to do so again.

items.title: 美債殖利率恐引發市場風暴！「債券之王」警告：利率持續走高將放大AI與私人信貸風險
items.title_en: U.S. Treasury Yields May Spark Market Storm! The "Bond King" Warns Rising Rates Could Amplify AI and Private Credit Risks
paras: 有「債券之王」之稱的DoubleLine Capital投資長Jeff Gundlach警告，投資人應提防利率進一步攀升。儘管美國公債殖利率近期已升至近20年高點，但他認為，利率仍可能大幅走高，並對金融市場造成重大衝擊。
根據《Business Insider》報導，Gundlach近日在曼哈頓一場活動中分享最新市場展望時表示，若利率「真的開始上升」，美國經濟可能因此陷入衰退，甚至引發一波企業倒閉潮。
他並未明確說明利率須升至多高或以多快速度攀升，才會觸發上述風險。不過，他提出一種可能情境：長天期公債殖利率突破6%，迫使美國財政部進一步加大干預力度，以平抑市場波動。
美國財政部近期才宣布，將買回總值60億美元的長天期公債，但Gundlach認為，利率走高最終可能在市場引發「某些重大變化」，尤其是當融資成本上升，與AI交易及私人信貸市場的脆弱性相互作用時，風險可能進一步擴大。
Gundlach表示：「我們看起來就像正朝著某種碰撞局面前進，違約事件將開始快速、大量地出現。」
在全球政府債券遭拋售之際，各國債券殖利率持續走高。美國10年期公債殖利率近期突破5%這項重要關卡。
這個被視為債券市場心理關鍵的水準，反映投資人對油價上漲及其通膨影響感到不安，並因此將更高的利率納入定價。
美國財政部推出公債買回計畫後，投資人的情緒也未獲得太大安撫，殖利率反而在計畫宣布當天跳升。市場擔心的是，這項措施並未處理目前最受關注的財政問題。
Gundlach表示，考慮到通膨及油價面臨上行風險，殖利率可能持續逐步攀升。他指出，市場本週或許因聯準會（Fed）展現抑制通膨的意願而受到鼓舞，但各國很快將需要補充石油儲備；這些儲備在伊朗戰爭期間已被大量動用。
他認為，新增需求可能進一步推升油價，尤其當通膨預期失去錨定、消費者因預期價格上漲而開始囤積商品時，可能形成自我實現的通膨螺旋。
Gundlach指出，聯準會可以透過升息壓抑通膨，但利率走高也會增加政府與民間債務的利息支出，進而加重金融市場壓力。
他推測，高利率最終可能與經濟其他領域的脆弱性相互作用，包括市場對AI企業估值過高的疑慮，以及私人信貸市場近期浮現的壓力跡象。
在形容市場走勢時，Gundlach表示：「長天期美國公債殖利率最沒有阻力的方向是上升。」
Gundlach因曾預測次級房貸危機而廣為人知。他表示，目前正考慮避開股票。今年稍早，他也曾警告通膨可能升溫，並建議投資人增加現金、商品、黃金及其他實體資產在投資組合中的配置。
paras_en: DoubleLine Capital chief investment officer Jeff Gundlach, known as the "Bond King," warned investors to guard against further rate hikes. Although U.S. Treasury yields have recently risen to near‑20‑year highs, he believes rates could still climb sharply and deliver a major shock to financial markets.
According to Business Insider, Gundlach said at a Manhattan event that if rates "really start to rise," the U.S. economy could slip into recession and even trigger a wave of corporate bankruptcies.

He did not specify exactly how high or how fast rates would need to go to trigger those risks, but he outlined a possible scenario: long‑term Treasury yields breaking above 6%, forcing the Treasury to step up intervention to calm market volatility.

The Treasury recently announced a buy‑back of $6 billion of long‑term Treasuries, but Gundlach thinks higher rates could eventually cause "some major changes" in the market, especially as rising financing costs interact with the fragility of AI trading and private‑credit markets, magnifying risk.
Gundlach said, "It looks like we are heading toward some kind of collision scenario, and default events will start to appear quickly and in large numbers."
As governments worldwide sell off bonds, yields are climbing across the board. The U.S. 10‑year Treasury yield recently breached the key 5% threshold.
That level is seen as a psychological benchmark for the bond market, reflecting investors' unease about rising oil prices and their inflationary impact, prompting higher rates to be priced in.

Even after the Treasury launched its buy‑back program, investor sentiment was not soothed; yields actually spiked on the day the plan was announced. Markets worry the measure does not address the most pressing fiscal concerns.

Gundlach said that, given upside risks to inflation and oil prices, yields could keep climbing gradually. He noted the market might be buoyed this week by the Fed's willingness to curb inflation, but countries will soon need to replenish oil reserves that were heavily drawn down during the Iran war.

He believes new demand could push oil prices higher, especially if inflation expectations become unanchored and consumers start stockpiling goods in anticipation of price hikes, potentially creating a self‑fulfilling inflation spiral.
Gundlach pointed out that the Fed can raise rates to suppress inflation, but higher rates also increase interest costs for both government and private debt, adding pressure to financial markets.

He speculated that high rates could eventually interact with vulnerabilities in other parts of the economy, including concerns that AI company valuations are overly lofty and emerging stress signs in the private‑credit market.
Describing the market trajectory, Gundlach said, "The path of least resistance for long‑term U.S. Treasury yields is upward."

Gundlach became widely known for predicting the sub‑prime mortgage crisis. He said he is now considering staying out of equities. Earlier this year he warned that inflation could heat up again and advised investors to increase allocations to cash, commodities, gold and other tangible assets.

items.title: 那指季調今生效！SpaceX權重翻倍 逾8000億美元被動資金將調倉
items.title_en: Quarterly Rebalancing Takes Effect! SpaceX Weight Doubles, Over $800 Billion Passive Capital Will Adjust Holdings
paras: 根據彭博取得的數據，納斯達克100指數季度再平衡將於周一(21日)生效，屆時 SpaceX(SPCX-US) 的權重將升至 2.82%，較目前約 1.28% 大幅提高。
這項以上週五(18日)收盤價計算的最終數據，與指數編製公司先前公布並經彭博社報導的預估權重相符。
SpaceX 目前權重偏低，主要與該公司今年 7 月納入指數時的情況有關。
當時大部分股份仍處於閉鎖期，無法在公開市場交易，因此即使納斯達克修改規則，允許新上市的大型股更快納入指數，並取消至少 10% 股份須可公開交易的規定，SpaceX 的權重仍受到限制。
這波預期的權重調升，將開始拉近一個不尋常的落差。SpaceX 以超過 2 兆美元的市值，名列那斯達克 100 指數第7大企業，但其現行權重在該指數的佔比，卻連前20名都排不上。
權重擴大至關重要，因為追蹤該基準指數的被動型基金必須相應調整其持股。
其中包括規模達 4,820 億美元的景順 QQQ 信託系列一（Invesco QQQ Trust Series 1)(QQQ-US) ，也是全球規模最大的 ETF 之一。目前全球有超過 200 項投資產品追蹤納斯達克 100 指數，管理資產總額逾 8,000 億美元。
那斯達克 100 指數涵蓋在那斯達克交易所掛牌的最大型非金融企業。雖然納入標準並未設有最低市值門檻，但企業平均每日成交量須至少達 20 萬股，並符合其他條件。
麥格理分析師 Edward Yoon 表示，在多項因素共同牽動市場之際，近期的指數再平衡事件已變得更加重要。
他指出，這些指數變動正值總體經濟背景更為動態之際，包括涉及伊朗的地緣政治發展、持續的通膨疑慮、重燃的關稅不確定性、利率走勢，以及人工智慧與科技股持續的波動，都在在牽動著本次權重調整中許多成分股的股價表現。
paras_en: According to data obtained by Bloomberg, the quarterly rebalancing of the Nasdaq-100 index will take effect on Monday (the 21st), at which point SpaceX (SPCX-US) will see its weight rise to 2.82%, a sharp increase from the current roughly 1.28%.
The final figures, calculated using Friday’s (the 18th) closing prices, match the estimated weights previously released by the index provider and reported by Bloomberg.
SpaceX’s current weight is low mainly because of the circumstances when the company was added to the index in July of this year.

At that time most of its shares were still in a lock‑up period and could not be traded publicly, so even though Nasdaq changed the rules to let newly listed large caps enter the index faster and removed the requirement that at least 10% of a company’s shares be publicly tradable, SpaceX’s weight remained constrained.

The expected weight increase will begin to close an unusual gap. With a market value of over $2 trillion, SpaceX ranks as the seventh‑largest company in the Nasdaq‑100, yet its current weight in the index does not even place it among the top 20 constituents.
Weight expansion is crucial because passive funds that track the benchmark must adjust their holdings accordingly.

Among them is the Invesco QQQ Trust Series 1 (QQQ-US), which manages $482 billion and is one of the world’s largest ETFs. More than 200 investment products globally track the Nasdaq‑100, with total assets under management exceeding $800 billion.

The Nasdaq‑100 comprises the largest non‑financial companies listed on the Nasdaq exchange. Although there is no minimum market‑cap threshold for inclusion, companies must have an average daily trading volume of at least 200,000 shares and meet other criteria.
Macquarie analyst Edward Yoon said that amid multiple factors moving the market, the recent index rebalancing has become even more significant.

He noted that these index changes come at a time of a more dynamic macro backdrop, including geopolitical developments involving Iran, ongoing inflation concerns, renewed tariff uncertainties, interest‑rate trends, and the continued volatility of AI and technology stocks, all influencing the price performance of many constituents in this weight adjustment.

台股盤前要聞 

1.經濟部18日召開2026年第2次電價費率審議會，會後記者會由次長賴建信主持。審議委員會指出，影響本期電價的主因為中東戰事，國際燃料價格大漲導致發購電成本大幅攀升，為避免引發國內物價波動，會議決議支持優先爭取政府撥補預算711億元，因此本次電價調整暫不決定，留待今年12月併入第3次電價審議會審議輸配電費率時再行討論，意味著最快調漲電價的時間點將落在明年1月。
2.台北股市18日在各不確定性消除之後，大盤終場以上漲892.75點收盤，報47180.75點，成交值逾1.07兆元，龐大量能潮補足昨日未能站穩4700點遺憾。外資在期貨、現貨同步做多，買超869.94億元創台股中第5大買超，加碼個股以記憶體族群為主。儘管外資連續2日買超共991.79億元，全周仍賣超184.64億元。
3. 上海航運交易所18日公布最新上海出口集裝箱運價指數，綜合指數較前一期上漲25.65點至3687.83點，漲幅約0.7%，已連續第八周上漲；其中美東、美西線也持續走強。
4. LED大廠富采(3714-TW)18日代子公司富采光電公告自3/9-3/18期間，依市場價格取得關係人友達(2409-TW)普通股股票共計73128張，每股平均價格為20.48元，交易總金額約達14.98億元。本次交易完成後，富采累計持有友達持股比例達0.97%，主要目的在於增進集團策略協同效益，發揮永動機策略結盟綜效，並持續擴大集團在高附加價值應用的市場版圖。
5. 仁寶(2324-TW)18日與鋐寶分別召開董事會，並於晚間召開重訊記者會，通過以現金為對價的股份轉換案，此次股份轉換對價為每股18.5元，股份轉換完成後，鋐寶將成為仁寶100%持股子公司。

paras_en: The Ministry of Economic Affairs held the second 2026 electricity tariff review meeting on the 18th, with Deputy Minister Lai Chien‑hsin chairing the post‑meeting press conference. The review committee said the main factor affecting the current electricity price is the Middle‑East conflict, which has driven international fuel prices sharply higher and pushed power‑generation costs up dramatically. To avoid domestic price volatility, the meeting resolved to prioritize securing a government subsidy of NT$71.1 billion, so the tariff adjustment will not be decided now and will be deferred to the third tariff review in December when transmission and distribution rates are examined. This means the earliest possible price hike would be in January 2027.

On the 18th, after various uncertainties cleared, the Taipei stock market closed up 892.75 points at 47,180.75, with a turnover exceeding NT$1.07 trillion, recouping the missed 4,700‑point level from the previous day. Foreign investors bought net NT$86.994 billion in both futures and spot markets, ranking as the fifth‑largest net purchase in Taiwan equities, focusing mainly on memory‑chip stocks. Although foreign investors posted net purchases for two consecutive days totaling NT$99.179 billion, they still recorded a net sell of NT$18.464 billion for the week.

The Shanghai Shipping Exchange released its latest Shanghai Export Container Freight Index on the 18th. The composite index rose 25.65 points to 3,687.83, an increase of about 0.7%, marking the eighth consecutive week of gains. The East‑Coast US and West‑Coast US routes also continued to strengthen.

LED giant Foxconn (3714‑TW) announced on the 18th, via its subsidiary Foxconn Optoelectronics, that it purchased 73,128 shares of related party AU Optronics (2409‑TW) at an average price of NT$20.48 per share between March 9 and March 18, for a total transaction value of approximately NT$1.498 billion. After the deal, Foxconn’s cumulative stake in AU Optronics reaches 0.97%. The acquisition aims to enhance group strategic synergies, leverage the “perpetual motion” alliance effect, and further expand the group’s footprint in high‑value‑added applications.

Wistron (2324‑TW) held board meetings with Honbo on the 18th and later held a press conference, approving a cash‑for‑stock swap at NT$18.5 per share. Upon completion, Honbo will become a wholly‑owned subsidiary of Wistron, deepening its Edge‑AI strategy.
Electricity prices remain frozen as the review panel voted to prioritize securing a NT$71.1 billion government subsidy, with tariff rates postponed for combined review in December.
Foreign investors aggressively bought futures and spot stocks, netting NT$86.9 billion—the fifth‑largest net purchase on record—while still posting a net sell of NT$18.4 billion for the week.
<Shipping Index> A surge of shipments ahead of the ten‑day holiday lifted the SCFI for the eighth straight week, with both the US West Coast and East Coast lanes rallying.
Foxconn’s acquisition of 73,128 AU Optronics shares deepens the group’s “3+1” strategic alliance synergy.
Wistron’s cash payment of NT$18.5 per share to acquire Honbo’s entire equity strengthens its Edge‑AI positioning.
<Apple New Release> The iPhone 18 Pro series hits the market, with the three major telecom carriers deploying different pricing strategies to attract customers.
The three AI giants call for a slowdown, yet Wistron’s Lin Hsien‑ming and Pegatron’s Tong Tzu‑hsien remain optimistic about the AI industry.
Shengda Technology’s August revenue reached NT$321 million, a new high for the period, with analysts forecasting strong earnings growth before year‑end.
200 GB PD mass production eases material shortages, and Uni‑World KY’s Q3 results are expected to warm up quarter by quarter.
Wah Hsing Light’s new product line is projected to scale up in the second half of 2027, with institutional investors estimating that capacity expansion could trigger rapid growth.
Biomedical and drone sectors see major upgrades: Taiwan‑Kang Sheng, Ju‑Yang, Cai‑Yu, and Patriot Green Energy have all been approved for the Ministry of Economic Affairs’ A+ program.

items.title: 〈台股風向球〉升息利空出盡站回4萬7 惟提防中秋連假前賣壓
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market Outlook: Rate Hike Negatives Exhausted, Index Returns to 47,000; Watch for Pre‑Mid‑Autumn Holiday Selling Pressure
paras: 台股上周呈現聯準會升息後「利空出盡」態勢，加權指數反彈995.9點，站上47000點關卡，法人認為，有鑑於美國期中選舉壓力逐漸消化，本周可望持續看多，尤其美股記憶體指標Sandisk走強，有利推動台股記憶體股表現進而強化櫃買市場的短線交投信心，不過，隨著中秋連假到來、油價不確定因素仍高，仍須留意短彈的了結壓力來回拉鋸，使震盪加劇。
上周台股反彈近千點，投信呈現連4周買超，外資卻是連3周賣超，內外資對作反映國際資金的避險情緒升溫，但台股的強勁獲利展望穩住內資信心。
外資上周合計賣超185億元，主要賣超元大台灣50(0050-TW)達11.1萬張、凱基台灣TOP50(009816-TW)近8.2萬張、友達(2409-TW)7.2萬張、主動統一台股增長(00981A-TW)6萬張、中鋼(2002-TW)5.4萬張、彰銀(2801-TW)和群益台灣精選高息(00919-TW)均超過4.4萬張，南亞(1303-TW)4.3萬張。
台股交易員提到，瑞銀(UBS)最新報告大幅上修全球AI資本支出預測，其中約90%主要因記憶體成本攀升，推升記憶體股走勢，而記憶體股一般是中小股的信心來源，一旦被點火，連假前若無太大意外令櫃買指數的表現可期。
永豐投顧分析，FOMC如預期升息1碼，公債殖利率逐漸抬高，以適應通膨環境與高漲的油價，所幸目前市場普遍認為最快12月才可能再次升息，並非急遽收縮的環境，令短線變數消除，下次FOMC在10月28月召開，至少在10月下旬前市場可暫時擺脫利率政策不確定性干擾。
另一方面，美國期中選舉接近，根據經驗，選前壓縮過程會提前一個月，也就是對選舉結果沒信心的持股會在一個月前拋售，隨著台股震盪站上47000點，有擺脫盤局之勢。
paras_en: The Taiwan stock market showed a "negative news exhausted" pattern after the Fed’s rate hike last week, with the weighted index rebounding 995.9 points to break the 47,000‑point barrier. Institutional investors believe that, as the pressure from the U.S. mid‑term elections eases, the market can remain bullish this week, especially with the strong performance of the U.S. memory‑chip index Sandisk, which should boost Taiwan memory‑chip stocks and reinforce short‑term trading confidence in the over‑the‑counter market. However, with the Mid‑Autumn holiday approaching and oil‑price uncertainty still high, attention is needed on the pressure from short‑term profit‑taking that could intensify volatility.

Last week’s near‑1,000‑point rally saw mutual funds post a fourth consecutive week of net buying, while foreign investors recorded a third week of net selling. The contrasting flows reflect heightened hedging sentiment among international capital, yet the strong earnings outlook for Taiwan stocks keeps domestic confidence intact.

Foreign investors sold a total of NT$18.5 billion last week, led by net sales of 111,000 lots of Yuanta Taiwan 50 (0050‑TW), about 82,000 lots of KGI Taiwan TOP50 (009816‑TW), 72,000 lots of AU Optronics (2409‑TW), 60,000 lots of Uni-President Taiwan Growth (00981A‑TW), 54,000 lots of China Steel (2002‑TW), and over 44,000 lots each of Chang Hwa Bank (2801‑TW) and Qunyi Taiwan High‑Yield Select (00919‑TW), with Nanya (1303‑TW) at 43,000 lots.

A Taiwan market trader noted that UBS’s latest report sharply raised its forecast for global AI capital spending, about 90% of which is driven by rising memory‑chip costs, lifting memory‑chip stocks. Since memory stocks are a key confidence driver for small‑cap equities, a spark in that sector could keep the over‑the‑counter index performing well before the holiday, barring any major surprises.

According to Yongfeng Investment Advisory, the FOMC’s expected one‑point rate hike is pushing government‑bond yields higher to accommodate inflation and soaring oil prices. Fortunately, the market broadly expects the next possible hike not until December, avoiding a rapid tightening environment and removing short‑term uncertainty. The next FOMC meeting is set for October 28, so at least until late October the market can temporarily escape rate‑policy volatility.

On the other hand, with the U.S. mid‑term elections looming, history shows that the pre‑election compression of positions tends to start a month early, meaning investors lacking confidence in the outcome begin selling about a month ahead. As the Taiwan market steadies above 47,000 points, there is a chance to break out of the current trading range.

items.title: 集團作帳行情助攻 南亞、台塑化季底有望進行補漲
items.title_en: Group Accounting Moves Boost South Asia and Formosa Plastics' Q3 Gains
paras: 據統計，台股今(2026)年度已大漲約62.9％，隨著接近本(9)月底，集團作帳行情也備受關注，包括聯電(2303-TW)、鴻海(2317-TW)及台塑(1301-TW)集團，投信拚季底績效的最後衝刺期，可望提前於本周發酵。觀察台塑集團中的南亞，投信上周周成交量來到32.8萬張、連7周買超，台塑化則是周成交12.5萬張，投信連3周買超。
法人指出，集團作帳行以年度觀察，通常在6月底、12月底較明顯，不過在9月底包括自營商及外資也有機會介入季底作帳加碼，有望獲得補漲行情。
另隨著布蘭特原油期貨近期飆破每桶100美元，台塑四寶近來也成為盤面焦點，在油價持續波動加劇，除了塑化本業「金九銀十」旺季可期，也兼有產品持續轉型的相關優勢。
包括南亞近年因轉型有成，8月電子材料占比已達6成，加上受惠AI浪潮驅動下，上(8)單月營收更創近50個月以來新高。據外資最新發布的研究報告中，形容南亞轉型已成功「華麗轉身」，除了傳統業務逐步復甦外，高毛利的電子材料事業更迎接爆發性成長，給予的目標價持續提升。
台塑化(6505-TW)則因美伊停火衝突持續升溫，年增5成為四寶中年增率表現最佳，隨著內銷油品吸收金額上(8)月比7月增加，致全產品平均售價僅比上月增加9.3美元/桶，台塑化持續調整產品組合，增加差異化產品比例，提升平均售價。
法人表示，受惠季底集團作帳行情，加上投信拚季底績效的最後衝刺期限，可望在本周持續發酵，包括傳產類股，因為今(2026)年股價基期較低，多具備股價跌深或或落後題材，隨著作帳行情啟動，一旦外資買盤持續進駐下，股價有望呈現一波補漲機會。
paras_en: According to statistics, the Taiwan stock market has surged about 62.9% so far this year (2026). As the end of September approaches, group accounting activity is drawing attention, especially for the United Microelectronics (2303‑TW), Hon Hai (2317‑TW) and Formosa Plastics (1301‑TW) groups. Mutual funds, racing to improve their quarter‑end performance, may see the effect materialise early this week. Looking at Formosa’s South Asia unit, mutual‑fund trading volume last week reached 328,000 shares, marking seven consecutive weeks of net buying, while Formosa Plastics’ chemical arm saw 125,000 shares traded with three weeks of net buying.

Institutions note that group accounting trends are usually most evident at the end of June and December, but at the end of September proprietary traders and foreign investors also have opportunities to step in for quarter‑end accounting additions, potentially sparking a catch‑up rally.

With Brent crude futures recently breaking the US$100 per barrel barrier, Formosa’s four core businesses have become market focal points. As oil price volatility intensifies, the plastics and petrochemical segment looks set for a strong “golden September‑October” season, while the company also benefits from ongoing product transformation advantages.

South Asia has seen successful transformation in recent years, with electronic materials accounting for 60% of its business in August. Driven by the AI wave, its August revenue hit a 50‑month high. A latest foreign‑institution research report praised South Asia’s “spectacular turnaround,” noting that beyond a gradual recovery of traditional lines, its high‑margin electronic materials business is poised for explosive growth, prompting upward revisions of its target price.

Formosa Plastics Chemical (6505‑TW) posted the best year‑over‑year growth among the four core units, up 50% amid the heated US‑Iran cease‑fire conflict. Domestic fuel sales rose in August versus July, lifting the average product price by only US$9.3 per barrel from the previous month. The company continues to adjust its product mix, increasing the share of differentiated products to raise average selling prices.

Institutions say that the quarter‑end group accounting activity, combined with mutual funds’ final push for quarter‑end performance, could keep fermenting throughout the week. Traditional‑industry stocks, which started the year at relatively low levels and often suffer deep declines or lagging themes, may experience a catch‑up rally once foreign‑investor buying gains momentum as the accounting window opens.

items.title: 親子客首選 長榮航連11年獲評五星航空「家庭友善航空公司」拿世界第一
items.title_en: Parent‑Child Travelers' Top Choice: EVA Air Wins Five‑Star Rating for 11th Consecutive Year and Ranked World’s #1 Family‑Friendly Airline
paras: 擁有「航空界奧斯卡」美譽的知名航空業調查機構SKYTRAX公布第27屆全球航空公司大獎(World Airline Awards)，長榮航(2618-TW)不僅連續11年被評選為五星級航空公司，更勇奪2026年「全球最佳豪華經濟艙」、「最佳豪華經濟艙服務用品」和「全球最佳家庭友善航空公司」三項世界第一，此次共計囊括18個TOP 10獎項。
長榮航首席副總經理廖至維表示，今年除了連續11年獲SKYTRAX五星級航空的殊榮，也再次獲得多項全球航空大獎，成就得來不易，榮耀屬於全體長榮航空員工。
SKYTRAX Edward Plaisted執行長表示，長榮航空榮獲「全球最佳家庭友善航空公司」殊榮，這項成就充分肯定長榮航空致力於為攜帶孩童出行的旅客，打造更順暢、輕鬆且舒適旅程的努力。
此外，長榮航早在1992年領先全球率先推出豪華經濟艙，該艙等已成為成長最快速的客艙類別之一。
全球航空業權威調查機構SKYTRAX自1999年起舉辦全球航空公司大獎，針對航空公司的產品與服務進行全球旅客滿意度調查，並提供英語、法語、西班牙語、日語及中文等多國語言選項，是國際旅客選擇航空公司的重要參考指標。
paras_en: The renowned airline research firm SKYTRAX, often called the “Oscars of the aviation industry,” announced the 27th World Airline Awards. EVA Air (2618‑TW) not only retained its five‑star airline rating for the 11th straight year, but also captured three world‑first titles in 2026: Global Best Premium Economy Cabin, Best Premium Economy Cabin Service Products, and Global Best Family‑Friendly Airline, bringing its total to 18 Top‑10 awards.

EVA Air’s senior vice president Liao Chih‑Wei said that, in addition to the eleven‑year streak of SKYTRAX five‑star recognition, the airline has again earned multiple global aviation awards this year. He stressed that the achievement was hard‑won and that the honor belongs to all EVA Air employees.

SKYTRAX CEO Edward Plaisted said EVA Air’s award as Global Best Family‑Friendly Airline fully validates the carrier’s efforts to create smoother, more relaxed and comfortable journeys for passengers traveling with children.
Moreover, EVA Air pioneered the premium‑economy cabin worldwide back in 1992, a cabin class that has since become one of the fastest‑growing segments in the industry.

Since 1999, the authoritative global aviation research organization SKYTRAX has run the World Airline Awards, surveying worldwide passenger satisfaction with airline products and services. It offers surveys in English, French, Spanish, Japanese and Chinese, making it a key reference for international travelers when choosing airlines.

items.title: 台灣最大主動債ETF熱度不墜！00984D規模狂飆6.5倍 10/5第6次配息
items.title_en: Taiwan's Largest Active Bond ETF Keeps Hot Momentum! 00984D Surges 6.5‑Fold, Sixth Dividend on Oct 5
paras: 首檔突破百億大關的台灣最大主動式債券ETF迎來最新配息訊息！聯博投信主動式非投資等級債券ETF「聯博優選全球非投資等級債券主動式ETF」 (00984D-TW) 即將進行第六次配息，預計於10月5日除息，每受益權單位預估配息金額為0.085元，與前五次維持一致。想要參與本次配息的投資人，最晚需在10月2日買進。
00984D自今年1月成立以來，市場熱度持續高漲。截至9月11日，受益人數已大幅成長約528%；基金規模更自8月底率先成為台灣首檔突破百億元的主動式債券ETF後持續攀升，成長高達約651%，穩居台灣規模最大的主動式債券ETF寶座，顯見市場對收益型資產與主動式債券ETF的配置需求相當顯著。
聯博投信ETF發展部副總經理鍾郁婕分析，今年台股表現亮眼，但隨著股市集中度升高、波動加劇，投資組合分散配置的需求也隨之提升。相較股票，非投資等級債券波動度相對較低，且具備較高收益潛力，適度納入投資組合有助分散單一資產風險。同時，在美國通膨仍具黏著性、經濟展現韌性的背景下，非投資等級債的高債息可提供收益緩衝，較短的存續期間也有助降低利率波動對債券價格的影響。
此外，AI投資熱潮亦為非投資等級債市挹注新動能。全球超大型雲端服務商持續擴大AI資本支出，帶動參與資料中心建設與維護的「傳統經濟」非投資等級債發行企業受惠。另一方面，美國消費支出維持韌性，亦支撐博弈、休閒、住宿及零售等產業。
00984D透過主動選債與全球布局，以全球非投資等級企業債為核心，聚焦BB與B級券種，涵蓋能源、醫療、科技、媒體及基礎建設等產業。面對產業基本面分化，團隊動態調整配置，減碼基本面承壓的通訊與科技業，並靈活切入評價具吸引力的標的。
展望後市，鍾郁婕表示，00984D搭配約2.9年的短存續期間，能在控制信用與利率風險的同時掌握收益。在股市高檔震盪之際，將持續扮演投資人分散波動、增加收益來源的關鍵資產。

paras_en: The first Taiwanese active bond ETF to break the NT$100 billion mark is announcing its latest dividend. Lianbo Investment Trust’s active non‑investment‑grade bond ETF “Lianbo Preferred Global Non‑Investment‑Grade Bond Active ETF” (00984D‑TW) will make its sixth dividend distribution, with an ex‑dividend date of October 5. Each unit is expected to pay NT$0.085, the same as the previous five payouts. Investors who wish to receive this dividend must purchase the ETF no later than October 2.

Since its launch in January, 00984D has seen sustained market enthusiasm. As of September 11, the number of holders had grown about 528%, and the fund’s assets, after becoming Taiwan’s first active bond ETF to exceed NT$100 billion at the end of August, have risen roughly 651%, keeping it the largest active bond ETF in Taiwan and highlighting strong demand for yield‑oriented assets and active bond ETFs.

Zhong Yu‑jie, Deputy General Manager of the ETF Development Department at Lianbo Investment Trust, noted that this year’s Taiwan stock market performed well, but rising concentration and volatility have increased the need for diversified portfolios. Compared with equities, non‑investment‑grade bonds are less volatile and offer higher yield potential, making them a useful addition for risk diversification. Moreover, with persistent U.S. inflation and a resilient economy, the high coupons of high‑yield bonds provide a buffer, while their relatively short durations help mitigate price swings from interest‑rate changes.

The AI investment boom is also injecting new momentum into the high‑yield bond market. Global mega‑cloud service providers continue to expand AI‑related capital expenditures, benefiting “traditional‑economy” high‑yield issuers involved in data‑center construction and maintenance. At the same time, resilient U.S. consumer spending supports sectors such as gaming, leisure, hospitality, and retail.

00984D employs active bond selection and a global mandate, focusing on worldwide non‑investment‑grade corporate bonds, primarily BB and B‑rated issues across energy, healthcare, technology, media, and infrastructure. Facing sector‑specific fundamentals, the team dynamically adjusts allocations, trimming exposure to pressured communication and technology sectors while flexibly entering attractively‑valued opportunities.

Looking ahead, Zhong said that 00984D’s roughly 2.9‑year average duration allows it to manage credit and interest‑rate risk while capturing yield. Amid high‑level stock market turbulence, the fund will continue to serve as a key asset for investors seeking volatility diversification and additional income sources.

items.title: 成本推升及內需消費平淡 台系家電廠多軌迎戰下半年
items.title_en: Rising Costs and Tepid Domestic Demand: Taiwanese Home Appliance Makers Brace for the Second Half
paras: 受AI基礎建設需求與地緣政治推升原物料走勢影響，銅、鋁、鐵、塑膠粒及記憶體等製造成本居高不下，加上台灣內需市場消費不振，終端家電市場醞釀新一波漲價潮維持獲利，並適逢政府節能家電汰舊換新補助與貨物稅減免進入最後實施階段，聲寶(1604-TW)、三洋電(1614-TW)與禾聯碩(5283-TW)等本土家電品牌可望於下半年營運增添轉機。
面對源頭成本墊高，台灣家電業者普遍採取凍漲抗壓與新品調價雙軌戰略。市場普遍預期一般冰箱與洗衣機等品項漲幅落在3%至5%左右，其中液晶電視受到記憶體等關鍵零組件價格飆漲影響，成本反映幅度預料最為顯著。
業者多規劃在現階段夏季主力品項維持既有報價，待配合第四季新品發表、機型切換或新國家一級能效基準發布時，再逐波適度調漲售價以平攤製造成本壓力。
在個別台廠營運展望方面，聲寶前8月家電本業營收大致持平，其中冷凍櫃、洗衣機與液晶電視銷售相對突出，空調則透過聲寶與瑞智雙品牌維持成長。三洋電前5月合併營收為21.89億元，年減9.26%，公司看好下半年在夏季高溫及年底補助衝刺帶動下，表現將反轉優於去年並力拚將上半年跌幅全數補回。
禾聯碩今年營運預估與去年持平至維持成長，主力空調年銷量約20多萬台，並透過禾聯、夏普以及山田空調三品牌完整覆蓋高、中、低不同價位帶市場。
面對中國大陸品牌以低價策略跨海搶市，甚至將11公斤級洗衣機價格壓至萬元出頭，本土與外商家電業者紛紛將競爭主軸轉向全生命週期的後勤服務體系。
台灣業者積極擴充自有物流倉儲、配送安裝與全台直營維修據點，同時導入高階一級能效機種與醫療用特殊設備，外商如台灣LG亦鎖定30至49歲中高階客群，推動冷氣占比達6成的家電租賃與定期保養模式，藉此築起價格戰難以跨越的服務護城河。
為開創家電硬體銷售以外的長期收益，主要台廠亦加速跨足資產開發與高齡照護事業。聲寶旗下桃園龜山物流園區第一期A區已收租，B區預計2027年第1季取得使照交屋，土城橘青春樂齡宅則將於2027年第2季投入營運；三洋電位於新北市的泰山工廠都市計畫變更案亦持續配合內政部通盤檢討審議，逐步建構多元化的營運防護網。
paras_en: The surge in raw material prices driven by AI infrastructure demand and geopolitical factors has kept manufacturing costs for copper, aluminum, iron, plastic pellets and memory chips high. Coupled with weak domestic consumption in Taiwan, the end‑consumer appliance market is poised for a new wave of price hikes to sustain profits. This comes as government subsidies for energy‑saving appliance replacement and reductions in commodity taxes enter their final implementation stage, giving local brands such as Sampo (1604‑TW), Sanyo Electric (1614‑TW) and Heliant (5283‑TW) a chance to improve operations in the second half of the year.

Facing higher upstream costs, Taiwanese appliance companies are generally adopting a dual‑track strategy of freezing price increases to absorb pressure while adjusting prices on new products. The market expects typical items like refrigerators and washing machines to see price rises of about 3%‑5%, with LCD TVs expected to see the most pronounced cost‑pass‑through due to soaring memory‑chip component prices.

Most firms plan to keep current summer‑season pricing for core products, and then gradually raise prices in line with fourth‑quarter new‑product launches, model switches, or the release of new national Level‑1 energy‑efficiency standards, thereby spreading out manufacturing cost pressures.

Regarding individual Taiwanese manufacturers, Sampo’s home‑appliance revenue through August was roughly flat, with sales of freezers, washing machines and LCD TVs standing out, while air‑conditioners grew through Sampo’s two brands, Sampo and Ruis. Sanyo Electric reported combined revenue of NT$2.189 billion for the first five months, down 9.26% year‑on‑year, but expects a turnaround in the second half driven by hot summer demand and year‑end subsidies, aiming to fully recover the first‑half decline.

Heliant projects this year’s performance to be flat to modestly growing versus last year, with its main air‑conditioner line selling about 200,000 units annually and covering high, mid and low price segments through its three brands: Heliant, Sharp and Yamada Air‑Conditioning.

Confronted with mainland‑Chinese brands that undercut prices—pushing 11‑kg washing machines to just over NT$10,000—local and foreign appliance makers are shifting competition toward full‑life‑cycle logistics and service ecosystems.

Taiwanese firms are actively expanding their own logistics warehouses, delivery‑installation networks and nationwide direct‑service repair sites, while introducing high‑efficiency Level‑1 models and medical‑grade equipment. Foreign players such as LG Taiwan also target the 30‑49 age group, promoting rental and regular‑maintenance schemes for air‑conditioners that account for 60% of appliance rentals, thereby building a service moat that price wars cannot easily breach.

To generate long‑term revenue beyond hardware sales, major Taiwanese manufacturers are accelerating moves into real‑estate development and senior‑care services. Sampo’s first‑phase A‑zone of the Taoyuan Guishan logistics park is already leased, with Phase B slated for handover in Q1 2027; its Tucheng “Orange Youth” senior‑living project is expected to start operations in Q2 2027. Sanyo’s Tai‑shan factory redevelopment in New Taipei continues to align with the Ministry of the Interior’s comprehensive review, gradually building a diversified operational safety net.

paras_en: Specialty chemical maker China Chemical (1727-TW) is benefiting from robust demand for electronic‑grade sulfuric acid in advanced semiconductor processes. Institutional investors expect shipment volumes to gradually expand; the company has already begun limited shipments in May 2026. Coupled with a sharp rise in sulfur and other chemical raw‑material prices this half‑year, sulfuric acid and specialty product prices have climbed, boosting performance and lifting the stock 18.3% this week. The daily chart posted four consecutive red candles and the price broke the NT$100 mark.

Last week, China Chemical rose above all moving averages to NT$106 with foreign investors buying three consecutive days, posting four straight red candles on the daily chart and hitting a three‑plus‑month high. Weekly turnover reached 43,000 lots.

Institutions note that China Chemical’s electronic‑grade sulfuric acid is supplied to semiconductor customers for both mature and advanced processes. Supply to mature lines remains stable, while the advanced‑process production line passed certification in Q1 and has begun integration at customer sites.

In the first half of the year, China Chemical posted a net profit after tax of NT$0.66 per share, doubling year‑over‑year, and August revenue hit NT$256 million, a recent monthly record. The company now operates five production lines, with electronic‑grade sulfuric acid continuously receiving advanced‑process certifications.

China Chemical is currently undergoing certification with three additional semiconductor firms and continues R&D on other specialty products, including high‑frequency resin materials, aerospace fuel, and engineering‑plastic monomers.

Furthermore, institutions say China Chemical has secured a military‑grade specialty product contract slated for delivery in Q3 and has already received a second batch of orders from the customer, indicating strong future order visibility.
